name: Autumn Practice Weekend, Millbrook Institute
summary: An unscheduled weekend for up to 60 experienced secular practitioners at a long-running institute: silent mornings, three named teachers available, moderate walking. $890, itemised.
description:
Millbrook Institute has run secular contemplative programmes since 1987. The Autumn Practice Weekend is our least structured offering.

**Format**
Silence across the grounds until noon. No scheduled sessions. Teachers are available in the small halls and on the trails throughout; participants seek them out or not.

**Teachers**
- Dr. Helen Aske, clinical psychologist, MBSR teacher trainer (UMass CFM), 24 years teaching.
- Ravi Menon, Insight Meditation Society retreat teacher since 2004, MA Contemplative Psychology.
- Joanna Kittredge, LICSW, certified MBCT teacher, 15 years.

**Physical**
Moderate. The trail network is 12 miles and hilly.

**Level**
Participants should have a practice of some years. The weekend offers no instruction unless sought.

**Cost, itemised**
Accommodation (single room, two nights): $420. Meals (six): $150. Teaching and facilities: $320. Total $890.

**Cancellation**
Full refund to 30 days before; 50% to 14 days; no refund after, except in documented emergency, in which case a credit is issued. Transfers to another participant permitted at any time.
practical: Friday 4pm to Sunday 2pm, October. $890. Up to 60, single rooms. Three meals daily, dietary needs accommodated with notice. Bring walking shoes, layers, rain gear. Nearest airport Albany; institute shuttle from the Pittsfield bus, $25. Wifi in the main building. Registered 501(c)(3); financial statements available on request.
